svg.title: A ContinuousState is a timeline per entity
svg.desc: The ContinuousStateToSchedule test drawn as swimlanes: AGV-1 drives 2132->2133->2134 in six seconds; AGV-2 waits at 2117, then drives 2117->2133->2148. Each bar is one Motion. The action DAG built from it orders AGV-2's entry into node 2133 after AGV-1 has left it.
